data.gist: Collagen type 2 staining was increased in both treatment groups versus PBS, and appeared more uniformly distributed with micronized bone marrow.
data.plain: Antibody staining for collagen type 2, the main structural protein of healthy cartilage, was stronger in both treated groups than in saline controls, and its distribution looked more even in joints given the micronized bone marrow (a qualitative observation).
